'''''Nature Reviews Methods Primers''''' is a [[peer-reviewed]] and online-only [[scientific journal]] published by [[Nature Portfolio]]. Established in 2021,<ref name="cassi">{{Citation |last= |first= |year= |title=Nature Reviews Methods Primers (NRMPAT; 2662-8449) |publication-place= |page= |url= |via=[[Chemical Abstracts Service|CASSI]]}}</ref> it covers [[review article]]s on analytical, applied, [[Statistics|statistical]], theoretical and [[Computational science|computational]] methods used in the [[List of life sciences|life]] and [[Outline of physical science|physical sciences]].<ref name="aims-scope">{{cite web |title=Nature Reviews Methods Primers: Aims and Scope |url=https://www.nature.com/nrmp/aims |website=nature.com |access-date=October 28, 2025}}</ref> {{As of|2025|10|28}}, its [[editor-in-chief]] is Joseph Willson.<ref name="editors">{{cite web |title=Nature Reviews Methods Primers: About the Editors |url=https://www.nature.com/nrmp/editors |website=nature.com |access-date=October 28, 2025}}</ref>

==Abstracting and indexing==
The journal is abstracted and indexed in:
*[[Chemical Abstracts Core]]<ref name=MIAR/>
*[[Current Contents]]/Physical, Chemical & Earth Sciences<ref name=ISI/>
*[[Science Citation Index Expanded]]<ref name=ISI>{{cite web |url=http://mjl.clarivate.com/ |title=Web of Science Master Journal List |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |work=Intellectual Property & Science |access-date=October 17, 2025}}</ref>
*[[Scopus]]<ref name=MIAR>{{cite MIAR |title=Nature Reviews Methods Primers |issn= 2662-8449 |access-date=October 28, 2025}}</ref>

According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2024 [[impact factor]] of 56.<ref name="WoS">{{cite book |year=2025 |chapter= Nature Reviews Methods Primers |title=2024 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Clarivate]] |edition=Science |via=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports}}</ref>
